interpretation: Both folds are retrospective; these years have been observed in earlier strategy research. No untouched holdout claim. Future frozen observations alone provide new prospective evidence.
universe: Historical CSI300 main-board 60/00 members observed strictly before each signal; existing liquidity, 253-bar history, ST/delist and 6250-CNY per-lot affordability gates; no current-member backfill
signal_schedule: first trading session of month, information cutoff 18:30 Asia/Shanghai; next trading open execution

analyst.primary_measure: predicted net profit; no automatic EPS/share-basis conversion
analyst.availability: max(report_date end-of-day, create_time); missing create_time excluded; vendor-update-time proxy, not certified first-publication vintage

financials.availability: max(ann_date,f_ann_date) end-of-day; initial update_flag=0 type1/type5; dated type4 comparative reports usable only at later disclosure; same-day conflicting values excluded
financials.cashflow_scope: industrial comp_type=1 only; consolidated net profit and cash flow; TTM from independently available YTD/previous FY/previous YTD

surprise_scope_resolution_before_returns: Incremental surprise compares original parent-profit actuals and parent-profit guidance intervals with the prior company disclosure for the same fiscal period, scaled by known assets. Overlapping intervals = zero incremental evidence. Intervening express disclosure blocks the ambiguous comparison. Analyst NP and express NP docs do not certify parent/consolidated scope, so neither is silently cross-joined with actuals. First events without comparable guidance use seasonal SUE only.

additional_fixed_details.seasonal_sue_history: 8 prior quarterly seasonal differences, at least 6; denominator above 1 million CNY

combinations: Equal weight within each group; quality requires at least 3 of 4 observed factors; surprise requires at least 1; balanced = equal groups with at least 2 groups observed; missing never converted to zero evidence
industry_policy: Historical in/out intervals; unknown membership excluded from industry-neutral/risk-capped portfolio; raw factor IC retained separately with explicit coverage
risk_regime: Existing CSI300 adjusted close above MA126/MA252: stock budget 0/half/full; ETF remainder existing equal-risk core
execution: existing audited stock/ETF next-open ledger with historical fees, 100-share lots, suspensions, directional limits, T+1 and corporate actions
factor_evaluation: Monthly cross-sectional Spearman IC at 20/60 sessions measured next-open to later-open; raw and residualized for log market cap, price momentum and historical industry; top/bottom quantiles descriptive only, not shortable portfolio claims; overlapping horizons use block intervals
sensitivity: All four candidate families cost x2; balanced 6/10 holdings and one extra signal-session information delay; no best-sensitivity promotion
gates: Full and later-fold CAGR >= ETF; Sharpe >= ETF +0.05; max drawdown <=15%; paired Sharpe lower95 >0; ledger replay valid; zero corporate qualification blocks; sufficient coverage and >252 sessions; gates only support research ranking, not automatic activation
activation: Research only; preserve active.yaml and actual account; forward data may be cached by explicit runs, no new scheduled automation without user request
